# authzgx

> Inspect permission models for privilege-escalation paths, inheritance cycles and dead config. Reports problems with stable codes and exit codes, and writes an annotated storyboard.

authzgx is one of the `gxkit` agent-native review tools. Declare principals,
roles and permissions; `authzgx inspect` computes what each principal can reach
and proves whether a low-privilege principal can reach a sensitive permission,
returning the path.

## Install

```sh
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/authzgx" authzgx --help
uv tool install ./packages/authzgx      # from a clone
```

Needs Python 3.10+ and Pillow.

## Use

```sh
authzgx inspect auth.py            # report + storyboard, exit 1 on any error
authzgx inspect auth.py --json
authzgx inspect auth.py --no-storyboard
authzgx render  auth.py -o auth.png
```

A model file defines `model` (an `AuthModel`) or module-level `PRINCIPALS` /
`ROLES` / `PERMISSIONS` / `GRANTS` / `INHERITS` / `ASSIGNED` / `SENSITIVE` /
`LOW`.

## Checks

error: `escalation`, `cyclic-inheritance`, `dangling-grant`,
`dangling-assignment`, `dangling-inherit`, `dangling-reference` (a name in
`low`/`sensitive` that resolves to nothing).
info: `unreachable-role`, `orphan-permission`, `unreachable-permission`,
`empty-role`, `no-sensitive`, `no-low`, `no-permissions`.

Full documentation is in `README.md`.
